title: The map behind the sketch
sub: Model the business: before a data model gets sharper, each box needs a place on the organisation's map.
howto: Warm paper is China in the 1380s and its two registers; the films' dark glass is the university. Each part of the university's map has its colour: wheat for what it's for, salmon for who answers for it, green for where it's written, and lilac for what it means. Amber marks a question still open.
